module_summary: Synchronous FIFO with circular memory, write/read pointers and fill counter; async read output bypasses i_data when empty (read-on-empty).

anchors.name: mem
anchors.why: FIFO memory array written at wr_addr, read asynchronously at rd_addr.

anchors.name: i_wr
anchors.why: Write request; qualified by not-full to push i_data.

anchors.name: i_data
anchors.why: Write data stored into mem, also bypassed to o_data when empty.

anchors.name: i_rd
anchors.why: Read request from consumer; qualified by not-empty to pop.

anchors.name: o_data
anchors.why: Read data: mem at rd_addr, or i_data bypass when empty.

anchors.name: wr_addr
anchors.why: Write pointer, increments on accepted write, addresses mem.

anchors.name: rd_addr
anchors.why: Read pointer, increments on accepted read, addresses mem.

anchors.name: o_fill
anchors.why: Occupancy count, +1 on write, -1 on read; MSB gives full.

anchors.name: o_full
anchors.why: Full indication from fill MSB; blocks writes.

anchors.name: o_empty
anchors.why: Empty indication, cleared by concurrent write in read-on-empty mode.

anchors.name: w_wr
anchors.why: Qualified write enable: advances wr_addr, writes mem, updates fill.

anchors.name: w_rd
anchors.why: Qualified read enable: advances rd_addr, updates fill and empty.

anchors.name: r_empty
anchors.why: Registered empty flag; selects i_data bypass onto o_data.

groups.name: fifo_memory
groups.description: Circular data array holding queued words.

groups.name: write_side
groups.description: Qualifies write requests and advances the write pointer into mem.

groups.name: read_side
groups.description: Qualifies reads, advances read pointer, muxes mem or bypass onto o_data.

groups.name: occupancy_flags
groups.description: Fill counter and derived full/empty flags.
